_comment: Phase-1 schema example for the star-expansion 3D viewer. Hand-written reference for the Fano plane (data/typical_graphs/fano_graph.hymeko). Counts are exact and hand-verifiable: 7 hyperedges x arity 3 -> star incidence_nnz = 21; clique edge_count = 7 x C(3,2) = 21. The real exporter (export_star_expansion.py) fills canonical_hash and star.coo from the HyMeKo engine; this example omits the optional star.coo. The 3D layout is force-directed in-browser for legibility, NOT geometric ground truth.
